definitions.valid_rows: Count of true saved effective measurement-row mask entries, out of 374 calibrated rows.
definitions.increment_l2_um: Saved projected reconstructed command-vector L2 norm before normal controller gain/queue, in micrometres OPD-equivalent. Not pupil RMS or individual actuator stroke. Null on rejected reconstruction; archived zero is a sentinel.
definitions.held_boundary_actuators: Count of abs(applied[k-1]) >= effective stroke limit. Frame 0 is the recorded flat-DM start. Matches the pre-update exposure/PSF timing.
definitions.issued_clipped_fraction: Saved fraction of new requests beyond the bound after update k. It can remain nonzero while the queue drains after reconstruction rejection.
definitions.strehl: Unchanged saved H-band (1.65 um) pre-update instantaneous peak Strehl.
